title: Group Direct issues into projects
body: First real pilot delivery. Add lightweight projects within a product, assign or remove an issue from a project, and filter work by project. Keep the existing claim and human-verification workflow. Milestones and goals are separate follow-up work.
acceptance: Create and rename a project in the UI; assign and unassign a backlog issue; filter its tasks; expose project context to agents; preserve projects and assignments through restart and export/restore; reject cross-product links and stale project edits. Existing v1 data upgrades without losing records.

title: Add milestones and lightweight goals
body: After project grouping: ordered milestones within projects and lightweight goals linked to projects. Preserve the planning structures found in the Linear audit without portfolio dashboards.
acceptance: Create and edit milestones and goals; link them to the correct projects and issues; show progress without treating canceled tests as passes; round-trip all relationships in an archive.

title: Preserve parent, blocker, and related issue links
body: Support general work relationships independently of generated verification children. This is a prerequisite for lossless migration.
acceptance: Agents and UI can inspect parent/blocker/related links; invalid references and dependency cycles are rejected; imported legacy verification relationships remain distinguishable from new test runs.

title: Verify and package the native desktop for daily use
body: Exercise the real desktop window, restart/reconnect behavior, launch path, and update process. Record actual owner feedback; compilation alone does not satisfy this issue.
acceptance: Native UI launches, edits work, survives service restart, and leaves agent access available after closing. Provide a repeatable launch/update procedure and capture owner acceptance.

title: Make the Direct repository use Direct for agent handoffs
body: Add repository-specific working instructions and improve the CLI path used to read context, claim, renew, and submit. Direct is the write authority for this pilot only.
acceptance: An agent starting from repository instructions finds the correct local workspace and assigned issue, preserves request IDs on retry, renews its claim, and submits checks plus manual steps without using owner credentials or self-approving.

title: Add routine backups and prove recovery of the pilot
body: Protect the growing real workspace with explicit backup location, retained snapshots, and a recovery drill before broader adoption.
acceptance: Back up real pilot records and restore into a separate workspace; verify IDs, comments, projects, test runs and attachments when supported; document recovery and report failed backup attempts.

title: Capture a complete Linear migration source package
body: Read-only migration preparation after the pilot is usable. Capture current active and archived records, comments, documents, relationships and accessible attachments. Keep private exports out of Git. The old 468-issue count is only a baseline.
acceptance: Produce a timestamped coverage/error manifest with fresh per-team counts, original IDs and URLs, attachment checksums, and explicit missing coverage. Do not alter Linear records.

title: Build a repeatable Linear import dry-run and reconciliation report
body: Depends on planning records, relationships and a complete source package. Preserve history and legacy completion provenance; do not fabricate new verification passes.
acceptance: Dry-run one bounded project in an isolated workspace; reconcile records, comments and relationship counts; repeated imports create no duplicates; unknown states and missing files are reported; restore matches the imported archive.

title: Review ten real Direct deliveries before expanding adoption
body: Track real Direct development completions and owner feedback. Broader product adoption follows the importer dry-run. Keep one write authority per adopted scope; inspect Canvasm automated intake before its cutover.
acceptance: Ten real parent issues are human-verified, with evidence for any real failures/retests and a successful recovery drill. Record usability findings and an explicit per-product cutover decision. Billing cancellation is a separate owner action.

title: Add optional local MCP access over the same agent contract
body: Defer until CLI-based pilot workflow is established. Wrap existing commands without introducing a separate database or remote authentication dependency.
acceptance: A configured local client can read context, claim and submit using agent capabilities; forbidden owner actions remain forbidden; CLI continues to work independently.
